title: DEWS Wave 2 non-USD native supply checkpoints, CADC legacy plus successor registers, and declarative supply state clocks
summary: Moves CADD, KRWQ, XOFm, ZARm and tGBP from undated DefiLlama caps to complete clocked native rosters (#2169 Wave 2), counts CADC's legacy and reissued successor registers together (#2393), replaces the hardcoded state-clock list with a declarative plan flag that now also covers ZCHF and EURI, lets reviewed native stock outrank a DefiLlama list row for CoinGecko-detail assets, and records the Wave 2 deferrals and the wM Mantra EVM/Moca exclusion as reviewed coverage decisions.
impact: Reviewed preferred native supply (`shared/lib/onchain-supply-probe.ts`, `shared/lib/supply-perimeter-changes.ts`): `preferMcap: true` with enforced state clocks for `cadd-cad-digital` (Ethereum, Base, Solana Token-2022, Tempo TIP-20 and observed-zero-allowed Arc from Tetra's Supported Blockchains list; owner-approved restatement adding the Solana, Tempo and Arc stock DefiLlama 387 omits, about +3.0% at 2026-11-27 pins), `krwq-iq` (conserved Ethereum canonical supply with the five LayerZero OFT spokes reallocated out of it and the 11,000 KRWQ adapter remainder published under the non-canonical `KRWQ unattributed OFT escrow` label), `xofm-mento` and `zarm-mento` (single Celo registers), and `tgbp-tokenised` (eight StableTokenV1OFT EVM deployments including newly catalogued Arc plus the Solana mint, matching DefiLlama 317 to the unit). Each asset gets an asset-scoped perimeter cutover so DEWS compares native counts only after the change.

CADC perimeter (`shared/data/stablecoins/coins/cadc-cad-coin.json`, owner-approved): catalogues the four six-decimal successor contracts on Ethereum, Base, Polygon and Solana beside the six legacy registers and publishes their sum (2,919,924.46 CADC at 2026-11-27 pins versus DefiLlama 145's 2,080,046.67 legacy-EVM total). The migration burned legacy tokens and minted successors to holders, and legacy CADC remains redeemable for CAD through Paytrie, so both registers are outstanding claims; legacy legs may read zero as they redeem.

State clocks (`worker/src/cron/sync-stablecoins/supplemental-assets/onchain-supply.ts`): `requireStateClock` on `ReviewedOnchainSupplyPlan` replaces the 12-ID hardcoded list. ZCHF's eight and EURI's two EVM legs now date supply at EIP-1898 block-hash reads with closing header rechecks instead of the run clock, after pinned reads proved every routed endpoint pin-capable (including both Sonic endpoints). The same flag governs admission downstream: detail, live summary and carry-forward restoration accept a state-clocked preferred plan only as an `onchain-*` packet with its original `supplyObservedAt`, so a pre-cutover DefiLlama row or an unclocked cached native row is unavailable instead of taking the publication or cache-write clock. A valid clock alone is not proof of a pinned read: the reader marks each packet whose every leg it dated at pinned state with `supplyObservedAtKind: "pinned-state"`, a plan-flagged leg that cannot pin fails the read, and those consumers require the marker, so ZCHF's and EURI's pre-release run-clocked packets are neither shown nor restored. BUIDL, EURC, EURCV, BRLA and wM, whose reader already pinned every leg, keep their unmarked last publication until the first marked read replaces it.

Intake precedence (`worker/src/cron/sync-stablecoins/intake.ts`): a reviewed non-commodity preferred-native asset drops its DefiLlama list row even when its detail provider is CoinGecko, so ZARm's clocked native packet is no longer discarded as a duplicate (`usyc-hashnote` follows the same rule if DefiLlama relists 237).

Coverage decisions (`docs/supply-snapshot.md#coverage-decisions`): records JPYC as deferred under R1, A7A5 as unavailable for DEWS native velocity (no pin-capable Tron state read and an unvalidated Tron stock), JPYm, EUROP and the infeasible or below-cutoff tail as unavailable, and wM's Mantra EVM and Moca spokes (72,950.37 wM, about 0.104%) as a permanent reviewed exclusion that reopens if they exceed 0.5% of global wM, either chain gains a chain identity, or M0 lists another unenrolled spoke. Published wM supply is unchanged.

title: Require affirmative swap availability for Fluid pool prices
summary: Fluid pools must have current evidence that swaps are active before their prices can contribute to the aggregate DEX price or the pool challenge.
impact: Swap status follows the physical Fluid pool across provider aliases. Historical volume remains in its observation window when swaps pause.
The first published DEX generation was dated 2026-11-28 12:10:33 UTC.

title: ERC-4626 NAV vaults, mGLO six-chain preferred native supply, and Paxos Stable PYUSD reconciliation
summary: Adds five reviewed ERC-4626 NAV vaults (siUSD, fLiteUSD, svZCHF, Base Steakhouse Prime USDC, and StableEarn Prime PYUSD with explicit non-archive Stable RPC fallbacks) to authoritative convertToAssets pricing, activates six-chain preferred native supply for tokenized fund mGLO, reconciles PYUSD's StableChain contract from Stargate PYUSD0 to Paxos native PYUSDUUPS, and admits Own eUSD with a post-cutover core-aggregate entry date.
impact: Authoritative ERC-4626 NAV pricing (`worker/src/lib/authoritative-price-sources/erc4626-nav.ts`, `worker/src/lib/authoritative-price-sources/helpers.ts`): registers `siusd-infinifi` (parent `iusd-infinifi`), `fliteusd-fluid` (`usdc-circle`), `svzchf-frankencoin` (`zchf-frankencoin`, `allowFreshReplaySafeSingleSourceParent`), `steakusdc-steakhouse-base` (`usdc-circle` on Base), and `gpyusdse-galaxy` (`pyusd-paypal` on StableChain, extending `defineRegistryErc4626NavVault` with explicit `rpcUrls` backed by `SUPPLY_RPC_DEFAULTS.stable` rather than expanding archive-assuming `PUBLIC_RPC_URLS`).

Reviewed preferred native supply and PYUSD Stable reconciliation (`shared/lib/onchain-supply-probe.ts`, `shared/lib/supply-perimeter-changes.ts`, `shared/data/stablecoins/coins/pyusd-paypal.json`): adds `mglo-midas-fasanara` (`preferMcap: true`, six additive EVM deployments across Base, Robinhood Chain, Ethereum, X Layer, observed-zero-allowed Optimism and Monad via native DepositVaults and zero-balance LayerZero burn-and-mint adapters, with an asset-scoped perimeter cutover) and updates `pyusd-paypal`'s StableChain deployment from legacy Stargate Hydra `PYUSD0` (`0x99af...`, $1.14) to Paxos native `PYUSDUUPS` (`0x28f1f38a9f7db1f769a71af0a13e8bace2ab0e9f`, $23.96M) across contracts, bridge routes, and native Mint Authority.

Core-aggregate admission, dependency linkers, and yield ownership: admits `eusd-own` (Robinhood Chain, `llamaId: "484"`, `geckoId: "own-eusd"`) with a `2026-11-27` post-cutover core-aggregate entry date (`CORE_AGGREGATE_V2_POST_CUTOVER_ENTRY_DATES`); admits `bread-bread-coop` (Gnosis `escrow-balance` wrapper over `sdai-gnosis` redeeming to `xdai-gnosis`); wires reserve linkers from `yzusd-yuzu` to `mglo-midas-fasanara` and from `alusd-alchemix` to `siusd-infinifi` and `fliteusd-fluid`; and hands off parent yield ownership from `iusd-infinifi` to `siusd-infinifi` with an explicit `ownershipHandoffs` record while preserving `zchf-frankencoin`'s module-wide Savings opportunity alongside `svzchf-frankencoin`'s native wrapper rate.
